get_public_ip.description: Look up the public IP address that ipify sees for the outbound request. Choose IPv4, IPv6, or let ipify return whichever address family the network provides.
get_public_ip.name: get_public_ip

parameters.description: Which address family to return: 'ipv4' (the default), 'ipv6', or 'any' to let ipify choose IPv4 or IPv6.
parameters.name: ip_version

description: Look up your public IP address from ipify's keyless public API, no account or API key required. Works with both IPv4 and IPv6.
